name: softmax_fma_exp_approx
description: Softmax using a six-FMA polynomial approximation for exp2.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> REDUCE(max) -> LOAD(subtract) -> FMA(poly1) -> FMA(poly2) -> FMA(poly3) -> FMA(poly4) -> FMA(poly5) -> FMA(poly6) -> REDUCE(sum) + STORE(exp scratch) -> LOAD(exp scratch) -> FMA(div) -> STORE(output)

name: softmax_exp2_unit
description: Softmax using a dedicated EXP2 unit; EXP2 replaces the six dependent FMA polynomial stages.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> REDUCE(max) -> LOAD(subtract) -> EXP2 -> REDUCE(sum) + STORE(exp scratch) -> LOAD(exp scratch) -> FMA(div) -> STORE(output)

name: rmsnorm_sweep
description: RMSNorm is modeled as per-row input, reduction, rescale, shared weight load, and output store.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> FMA(square) -> REDUCE(sum) -> FMA(scale) -> LOAD(weight shared) -> FMA(mul) -> STORE(output)

name: silu_fma_exp_approx
description: SiLU using a six-FMA polynomial approximation for the exponent stage.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> FMA(negate) -> FMA(poly1) -> FMA(poly2) -> FMA(poly3) -> FMA(poly4) -> FMA(poly5) -> FMA(poly6) -> FMA(add1) -> FMA(div/mul) -> STORE(output)

name: silu_exp2_unit
description: SiLU using a dedicated EXP2 unit; EXP2 replaces the six dependent FMA polynomial stages.
dependency_chain: LOAD(input) -> FMA(negate) -> EXP2 -> FMA(add1) -> FMA(div/mul) -> STORE(output)

name: rope_sweep
description: RoPE mixes shared theta data with per-row input and output streams.
dependency_chain: LOAD(theta shared) -> FMA(angle) -> LOAD(input) -> FMA(real/imag) -> STORE(output)
